name: Station charger DC-output failure indication
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Reports the charger's defined output failure condition separately from its AC input status.
description: Reports the charger's defined output failure condition separately from its AC input status. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Charger output supervision” at the input and “DC-output fault alarm” at the output. The monitored failure criterion must be specified.
